clue.text: A writer went on about the French and got through

parts.note: a pen is the tool a writer uses, standing for the writer
et is the French word for 'and'
rated is an old verb for scolded, nagged or went on at someone

explanation.surface: Someone with a pen complained about the French and somehow passed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'went on about' gives RATED (berated); it is placed last although it comes before the French word in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To penetrate is to pierce or pass right into something, so it means made it through.

clue.text: Left behind the hearing aid? Lord!

indicators.note: behind places the word for left after the word for the hearing organ

parts.note: the ear is the organ that aids hearing, read playfully

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry on finding a hearing aid has been left somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: An earl is a nobleman, one of the British peers addressed as a lord.

clue.text: Listen agitatedly and cease being civil

indicators.note: something agitated is stirred up, so the six letters of the next word are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to listen anxiously and stop being polite.
explanation.definitionFit: To enlist is to join the armed forces, so a civilian stops being one.

clue.text: Sort of cheese provided for a woman without a home

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the woman's name goes around the home

parts.note: Rita is a woman's name
a cot is a small cottage, a modest home

explanation.surface: Cheese is set aside for a homeless woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' in the surface, but here it has its old sense of outside, so the name surrounds the home.
explanation.definitionFit: Ricotta is a soft Italian whey cheese, one kind of cheese.

clue.text: Until the latter part of April there'll be work

parts.note: to can mean until, as in 'from nine to five'

indicators.note: the latter part of the word April here is its closing pair of letters

explanation.surface: A promise of labour lasting until late April.
explanation.walkthrough: 'latter part of' takes the last two letters of April, IL, not just one.
explanation.definitionFit: Toil is hard labour, a synonym for work.

clue.text: Plant a quarter inside to advantage

indicators.note: inside puts the compass point within the phrase meaning benefit

parts.note: to do good is to benefit or advantage someone
W, west, is one of the four quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: Advice to place a quarter of something inside for best effect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to advantage' reads as an adverb, but it is the verb phrase 'to do good', with the quarter set inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogwood is a flowering shrub or small tree, a kind of plant.

clue.text: Restraint shown by the head after some grub

indicators.note: after places the headland word behind the grub word

parts.note: a gentle is a maggot, a grub used as fishing bait
a ness is a headland, a head of land

explanation.surface: A headmaster showing self-control after a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: GENTLE as a maggot is an angler's word; NESS appears in place names like Loch Ness and Skegness.
explanation.definitionFit: Gentleness is mildness of manner, a holding back from force.

clue.text: To lie or perhaps sit is prescribed for this malady

parts.note: to fib is to tell a small lie

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the short word before it could be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: Lying down or sitting is the treatment ordered for this illness.
explanation.walkthrough: Only the two letters of 'or' are turned around by 'perhaps'; the remaining words stay as printed. The surface sounds like a doctor's orders for rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Fibrositis is inflammation of fibrous tissue causing muscular pain, an illness.

clue.text: An enchanting creature, in general superintelligent

indicators.note: in signals that the letters sit inside the following long word

explanation.surface: A magical being that is, broadly speaking, extremely clever.
explanation.definitionFit: A peri is a fairy or beautiful spirit in Persian mythology.

clue.text: Playing — prepared for defeat

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, so the three letters are reworked

parts.note: a licking is a thrashing or heavy defeat

explanation.surface: A team playing though braced for a beating.
explanation.definitionFit: Frolicking is playing about merrily.

clue.text: The man investing money in a lake

indicators.note: investing in its sense of clothing or surrounding: the lake word wraps the money

parts.note: a lake is a body of water
L stands for pound, as in the sign for pounds sterling

explanation.surface: A man putting cash into a lake venture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'investing' looks financial but is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Walter is a man's name, so it stands for the fellow named.

clue.text: Order the construction to be set taut

indicators.note: construction means building, so the letters are built into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction that a structure should be pulled tight.
explanation.definitionFit: A statute is a law, a decree or order made by a legislature.

clue.text: Fish cut into narrow pieces for youngsters

indicators.note: cut into puts the fish within the word for narrow pieces

parts.note: strips are long narrow pieces
ling is a long cod-like sea fish

explanation.surface: Fish sliced into thin portions to serve children.
explanation.definitionFit: Striplings are young lads, adolescents.

clue.text: Following a take-over the directors were real swine

definitions.text: Following a take-over the directors were real swine

parts.words: Following a take-over the directors were real swine
parts.note: reads as a jibe at a boardroom coup; really the 1945 Orwell fable where pigs seize the farm and end up running it

explanation.surface: A complaint that after a takeover the new bosses behaved like pigs.
explanation.definitionFit: Orwell's novel shows animals taking over a farm, with pigs becoming its ruling class.

clue.text: Put out some wholesome victuals

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Serving a portion of healthy food.
explanation.definitionFit: To evict is to expel a tenant from a property.

clue.text: They're caring women — unlike in the stuff that's written

indicators.note: in places the word for different within the manuscript abbreviation

parts.note: MS is the abbreviation for manuscript, something written
other means different or unlike

explanation.surface: Caring women are said to be unlike the ones described in books.
explanation.definitionFit: Mothers are women who nurture and care for children.

clue.text: Many in gold appear inferior

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a large number
or is the heraldic term for gold

explanation.surface: Many people in gold jewellery look less impressive.
explanation.definitionFit: Minor means lesser or of lower rank.

clue.text: Shun a number cipher on the identity card

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five
a cipher is a zero, written O
ID is short for identity card

explanation.surface: Ignore a coded number printed on an ID card.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid someone is to keep away from or steer clear of them.

clue.text: Fence the track

definitions.meaning: a fence made of horizontal bars, or one bar of it
the metal lines a train runs on

explanation.surface: Building a barrier around a racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: A rail is a bar forming a fence, and the rails are the steel lines of a railway.

clue.text: Indulge outside right, though insolent

indicators.note: outside puts the word for pamper around the letter for right

parts.note: to pet is to pamper or indulge

explanation.surface: Spoiling a cheeky outside-right on the football pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside right' looks like a football position; split it, 'outside' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Pert means cheeky or impudent.

clue.text: Pole shut up by Evelyn Waugh

parts.note: S is the south pole
to coop is to confine or pen in

explanation.surface: A Polish man silenced by the novelist Evelyn Waugh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a Polish person but is a magnetic pole, here south.
explanation.definitionFit: Scoop is Waugh's 1938 satirical novel about Fleet Street journalism, a book by him.

clue.text: The individual resolving to be an immigrant

definitions.meaning: the person who decides or concludes something
someone who comes to live in a new country

explanation.surface: One person deciding to move abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: One who settles a dispute or matter resolves it; a colonist who settles in a new land is an incomer.

clue.text: Eat only sparingly of meat in London

parts.note: to peck at food is to eat only a little
ham is cured pork

explanation.surface: A diner in London barely touching the meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Peckham is a district of south-east London.

clue.text: Coppers remained to allow for a little drama

parts.note: P is penny or pence, copper coins
lay, past of lie, as in staying put
to let is to allow

explanation.surface: Police who stayed behind to make room for a small show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coppers' looks like police but stands for pennies, copper coins: P.
explanation.definitionFit: A playlet is a short play, a brief dramatic piece.

clue.text: Gives refreshing rest to models repeatedly

definitions.meaning: lays down to rest, an old transitive sense
sits for a portrait or photo again, read as two parts

explanation.surface: A photo session that keeps resting its models.
explanation.definitionFit: To repose someone is to lay them at rest; to re-pose is to sit again for an artist, again and again.

clue.text: Began reading directions in dope-usage

indicators.note: in puts the compass directions within the rearranged letters
usage here means treatment, so the four letters before it are handled into a new order

parts.note: N and E are the compass directions north and east

explanation.surface: Someone started on the instructions for using a drug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'usage' rearranges the drug word before the compass letters go in; 'reading' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Opened means started, as in opened the meeting.

clue.text: Really can fit if well-made

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A piece truly can fit if it is crafted properly.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means actually or in truth, matching really.

clue.text: No longer available to a dyke-builder

parts.note: a dish that is off the menu is no longer available

explanation.surface: A dyke-building contractor is no longer free.
explanation.walkthrough: Offa's Dyke is a long earthwork along the England-Wales border.
explanation.definitionFit: Offa was an 8th-century king of Mercia who built a great earthwork along the Welsh border.

clue.text: Patriarch set against being seen in a garland

indicators.note: being seen in places the letter for against within the garland

parts.note: a lei is a Hawaiian garland of flowers
V is short for versus, against

explanation.surface: An elder refuses to be seen wearing flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: Levi, a son of Jacob, is one of the patriarchs who founded the tribes of Israel.

clue.text: Operating in sinister fashion

parts.note: sinister in Latin and heraldry means on the left side, so this describes favouring the other hand, not villainy

explanation.surface: Someone working in a wicked way.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinister is Latin for left, so working that way means favouring the other hand.

clue.text: Turn about and head-butt

parts.note: a go is a turn, as in 'your go'
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Wheel round and charge headfirst.
explanation.definitionFit: To gore is to pierce with horns, as a bull charges with its head.

clue.text: A team may be alarmed by one getting in the way

indicators.note: may be hints the letters of the next word could form something else
getting in places the numeral within the road abbreviation

parts.note: RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A football side might be scared by an opponent blocking its path.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' scrambles the whole of 'alarmed'; 'by' is a link. 'A team' is the definition, not part of the scared side in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Real Madrid is a famous Spanish football club, a sports side.
